sections.skill: Run a clear fulfillment and returns process

questions.prompt: What is fulfillment?

choices.text: Only the tax filing after a sale
Only the marketing before an order

questions.correct_answer: Everything from order to delivery
questions.intro: FULFILLMENT is everything from order to delivery: picking the item, packing, labeling, shipping and confirming. Set a clear processing time (for example "ships in 2 business days") and meet it. RETURNS need a clear process: how customers request a return, the time limit, the condition required, who pays return shipping, and how quickly refunds are issued. Inspect returned items, restock what is sellable, and track return reasons to fix causes.

sections.skill: A library's checkout and return desk

questions.prompt: The checkout desk is like what?
questions.correct_answer: Fulfillment
questions.intro: A library has a clear checkout process and a clear return process: due dates, condition expectations, and what happens to books that come back damaged. Returned books are checked and put back on shelves. A product business needs the same two desks: one for getting orders out correctly and one for handling what comes back.
